enabled.description: Master switch for Magic Context. Enables continuous session window management, turn compaction, tag tracking, and context reduction.

searchEnabled.description: Expose the standalone 'ctx_search' tool for local session history search. (Automatically superseded by unified 'memory_search' when AgentMemory tools are enabled).

noteEnabled.description: Expose the local SQLite note tool 'ctx_note'. Set to false when using AgentMemory so the agent relies exclusively on durable memory (memory_save).

historianEnabled.description: Enable background LLM-driven session compaction (Historian), which automatically summarizes older turns into <session-history> when historianModel is configured.

historianModel.description: Provider/model ID used for background Historian compaction (e.g. 'gm/gemini-3.8-flash' or 'lmxu/gpt-5.6-sol:high'). Empty keeps Historian inactive.

historianThinkingLevel.description: Optional reasoning/thinking effort level for the Historian compaction model ('off', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max'). Empty uses the model default.

agentmemory.enabled.description: Master switch to connect OMP to an external AgentMemory service for cross-session durable memory, project knowledge, and automated recall.

agentmemory.url.description: Base URL of the AgentMemory REST service (e.g. 'http://127.0.0.1:3111' or Tailscale node URL). AGENTMEMORY_URL overrides this.

agentmemory.secret.description: Bearer token authentication secret for the AgentMemory service. AGENTMEMORY_SECRET overrides this.

agentmemory.project.description: Explicit project name used to scope memories in AgentMemory. Blank defaults to the Git repository root or working directory.

agentmemory.agentId.description: Optional agent tag identifying this OMP instance in AgentMemory. AGENT_ID overrides this.

agentmemory.capture.description: Automatically capture session lifecycle events, tool outputs, and assistant observations to AgentMemory for background learning and indexing.

agentmemory.inject.description: Automatically recall relevant long-term memories and inject them as a cache-stable Context Projection block after each user message. Disable for tool-only search.

agentmemory.historianRetrieval.description: Allow the background Historian compaction process to query AgentMemory to produce richer, memory-aware session summaries.

agentmemory.memoryTools.description: Expose AgentMemory tools to the agent: 'memory_search' (federated search across session context and durable memories) and 'memory_save' (explicit durable fact write).

agentmemory.requireHttps.description: Fail closed with an error if a bearer secret would be transmitted over plaintext HTTP to a non-loopback host. Default false allows Tailscale/LAN HTTP.
